reviews.text:
I've been a patient of this clinic since I first got my Russian Blue cat. I initially chose it because it was close to my home, but the doctor's thoughtfulness and the staff's cheerful personalities were wonderful, and I feel incredibly fortunate to have found this hospital.

Even though my cat was still young, less than a year old, there was a time when she hit her head and couldn't walk. I was very worried at the time, but the doctor explained the possible treatment options and their respective risks, which put my mind at ease.

I've since moved, so I can't go back to the clinic, but my beloved cat (Munya) is now running around the house full of energy!
Thank you for the 5-star rating! All of our staff will continue to strive to ensure that everyone can enjoy spending time with the dogs and cats in a safe and comfortable environment!

The doctor was thorough in his examination and explanations, but after multiple visits over several weeks without complete recovery, we sought a second opinion, and our pet was cured in three days.

Regarding the reception service, during our initial visit, all of our pet's registration information, including name, date of birth, and address, was incorrect, and it took a considerable amount of time to correct. I felt that this important information should be handled with care.

Furthermore, even during subsequent phone calls, when I had questions I wanted to ask the doctor, the reception staff only gave perfunctory answers, failing to adequately address the concerns I, as a pet owner, wanted to discuss. It felt like a hospital that prioritizes processing patients rather than engaging with each individual pet owner. While I understand they have many patients, this experience taught me the importance of seeking a second opinion.

I was referred to this clinic by a colleague.

First, I was able to make a reservation through the app, and it notified me to come in when my turn was approaching, so I didn't have to wait long in the waiting room, which was very helpful.

The clinic was larger than I expected, and I appreciated that there were chairs scattered throughout the waiting area. It was also very clean.

The reception staff were very polite and kind. ✨️
There are two doctors, a man and a woman, and both are kind and attentive. The nurses are also all kind and polite. 😊✨️ My child really dislikes ear medicine and it's a struggle, but they were considerate and said, "Okay, we'll administer today's dose here. If ear drops are difficult, we have other methods as well," which was very helpful. I was surprised by how polite they were despite being busy.

The consultation fee is also reasonable, and although it's a bit of a distance from my home, I would still like to continue coming here in the future. ✨️

This hospital is a miracle.

My puppy, who wouldn't go outside despite attending various puppy parties, daycare, and even having a visiting trainer, was finally able to go outside after consulting with Dr. Ukai.

I feel that Dr. Ukai's calm and cheerful demeanor puts dogs at ease.

He listens attentively to my concerns, even though I'm just a layperson, but always puts the dog first... I'm so moved, it brings tears to my eyes.

They also hold puppy classes and teeth-brushing classes, so if you get a dog, I think you should first participate in their puppy class and then raise your dog without any problems by consulting with the doctor and staff.

I'm thinking of going to this hospital about half the time, since I've been going to this hospital since my previous dog was born, and the other hospital is a little far from my house.

The hospital waiting room and appointment system are designed to be stress-free for dogs.

I especially recommend this hospital for timid dogs or dogs that hate hospitals.

We had our cat spayed here.

She was calm and happy on the examination table for the first time, wagging her tail, and we felt completely at ease with the doctor's explanations and the examination itself. Even on the day of her post-operative check-up, she was rubbing her tail against the doctor and nurses, not wanting to leave despite being scared.

It wasn't just the skill and knowledge that gave us peace of mind; the relaxed personalities of the staff made us wonder why we hadn't come here sooner...

I saw some negative reviews, but both the male and female doctors we interacted with gave us the opposite experience; we felt a sense of security we hadn't experienced at any other hospital.

We would like to have our other pets here as well.

However, because it's such a homey hospital, the nurses' demeanor on the phone seemed a bit casual, but when we met them in person, they were incredibly kind, and we came to love this hospital.

I think every place is about compatibility, and our cat knew the answer.

🐱 Accurate diagnosis provides peace of mind.
🐾 The doctor and staff are kind and supportive.
🐱 They consider the cost and recommend only what is truly necessary.
🐾 The appointment app minimizes waiting times at the hospital.

I had lost faith in my previous hospital and sought a second opinion here. The female doctor immediately detected a tumor in my cat through palpation, something neither my previous hospital nor the emergency hospital could detect. While discovering the tumor was shocking, having a clear cause gave me a clearer picture of the future course of action.

The doctor not only speaks kindly to pets and calls them by name, but also empathizes with the owner's circumstances. Even in my financially limited situation, they provide specific guidance on what to prioritize, which is incredibly helpful. At my previous hospital, I was recommended and purchased expensive supplements, but I learned there were other things that were more important – it was a real eye-opener.

The staff are all warm and kind to both pets and their owners. Since you can check in through the app, waiting times at the hospital are short, making visits comfortable. It's a bit far from my house, and I take a taxi, but it's still a hospital worth going to.

Actually, at first, I was skeptical because the Google Maps reviews were so good, wondering if it was some kind of promotion. But after actually going there, I realized that everyone was writing reviews out of genuine gratitude. It's a hospital that deserves its high ratings.
